engine_rule: Core orchestration calls connectors only through health, capabilities, and invoke.

connectors.name: OpenRouter
connectors.description: Routes prompts to hosted model seats without binding the engine to one model provider.
risk_notes: Track model costs and context limits.
Do not send secrets unless the active skill allows it.

connectors.name: Agent Reach
connectors.description: Internet Intelligence connector for broad source discovery, reading, and evidence gathering.
risk_notes: Respect robots, source terms, and login boundaries.
Mark unsupported sources as partial instead of fabricating coverage.

connectors.name: Polygon.io
connectors.description: Market data connector for prices, sessions, tickers, candles, and trading evidence.
risk_notes: Trading outputs are decision support, not financial advice.
Validate delayed versus real-time data before use.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Repository, issue, pull request, and code search connector.
risk_notes: Respect private repo boundaries.
Avoid committing or pushing unless a write skill explicitly requests it.

connectors.name: Browser Automation
connectors.description: Browser adapter for webpage inspection, app verification, screenshots, and controlled UI actions.
risk_notes: Do not bypass authentication or consent flows.
Treat UI automation as high-latency and evidence-producing.

connectors.name: Local Filesystem
connectors.description: Workspace file read/write connector with explicit sandbox and approval boundaries.
risk_notes: Never overwrite unrelated user changes.
Destructive actions require explicit approval.

connectors.name: RunPod
connectors.description: GPU workflow connector for media generation, AI jobs, and hosted workers.
risk_notes: Estimate GPU cost before long jobs.
Never leave idle paid pods running.

connectors.name: Instagram
connectors.description: Instagram publishing, scheduling, comment, and analytics connector placeholder.
risk_notes: Reference-only connector until platform API access and publishing permissions are configured.
Publishing actions require explicit approval workflow selection.
Respect platform terms, rate limits, brand safety, and client account boundaries.
